name: Port of Echuca
bio_draft: Historic 1800s river port with its wharf, paddle steamer boarding and the Discovery Centre at Echuca.

name: Barmah National Park
bio_draft: River red gum forest on the Murray floodplain with Barmah Lakes, birdwatching, paddling, fishing and camping.

name: Dharnya Centre
bio_draft: Yorta Yorta cultural and environmental interpretation centre inside Barmah National Park.

name: Kyabram Fauna Park
bio_draft: Goulburn Valley wildlife park at Kyabram with native animals.

name: Terrick Terrick National Park
bio_draft: Small box-ironbark park near Pyramid Hill, with walking tracks and camping.

name: Murray-Sunset National Park
bio_draft: Victoria's largest national park, remote mallee country for 4WD, birdwatching, camping and stargazing.
